reference: lib/data/db.dart（Dart 参考实现，向量生成时点冻结）
encoding: 结构经 PRAGMA 标准抽取（不钉 CREATE 语句原文）；dflt 原样；表名字典序、列按 cid、索引按 name、索引列按 seqno、外键按 id

rules.extraction_rule: 表清单 = sqlite_master type=table 且非 sqlite_%（名字典序）；每表列 = PRAGMA table_info → {name,type,notnull,dflt,pk}（**列按名字典序输出**——物理 cid 序随迁移路径变化：ALTER TABLE 只能追加列，列序非契约，访问恒按列名；pk=复合主键序号 1-based）；索引 = PRAGMA index_list → {name,unique,origin,columns}（含 sqlite_autoindex_*，columns=PRAGMA index_info 按 seqno）；外键 = PRAGMA foreign_key_list → {table,from,to,on_update,on_delete}；库版本 = PRAGMA user_version
rules.ddl_text_note: 不钉 CREATE 语句原文（跨实现写法差异属实现细节），只钉 PRAGMA 可抽的结构语义；表级约束（UNIQUE/复合 PK/REFERENCES）经 autoindex + pk 序号 + foreign_key_list 三方见证
rules.migration_history: 7 段幂等迁移（squircle 单库）：v1→v2 补 app_settings；v2→v3 补 backgrounds；v3→v4 补 artifacts；v4→v5 migrateV5 六步（blocks 加 artifact_id / artifacts 加 bundle_id / 绑定搬家 block_id→blocks.artifact_id 悬空静默丢弃 / payload 投影清洗 block_id 键出列 / DROP artifacts.block_id——SQLite≥3.35 原生，老内核 12 步重建兜底 / collab 六表补齐）；v5→v6 collab_events 加 server_at_ms；v6→v7 collab_steps 加 starts_at_ms+ends_at_ms。幂等性=每段 IF NOT EXISTS 或 addColumnIfMissing，重跑零副作用（collab_db_migration_test 钉样）。向量对拍段=v4→v7（公开链 migrateV5/V6/V7）；v1→v4 三段为幂等补表文档级说明
rules.isomorphic_invariant: 新装（createAll）与逐段升级终态列集逐一相同（同构不变量，collab_db_migration_test 钉样）——Kotlin 迁移链须满足同一不变量：upgrade_isomorphic 的 expect.tables ≡ schema_snapshot 的 expect.tables
rules.onopen_pragmas: 连接级复刻清单（不进结构快照）：onOpen 执行 PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON（plans 自引用树与 blocks.plan_id 外键保护依赖此开关）；busy_timeout=5000（rawQuery 形态——带返回值 PRAGMA 经 execSQL 会被拒）；WAL 多写者缓解（单写队列在应用层）
rules.constraint_reject: probe 行插入必须被约束拒绝（UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY）；异常类非契约，只钉「必拒」外部可观察行为

legacy_ddl:
CREATE TABLE plans (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, spec TEXT, notes TEXT,
    open_items TEXT, min_viable_action TEXT,
    energy_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'light',
    tool_required TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'anywhere', reward_spec TEXT,
    importance INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deadline TEXT, estimate INTEGER,
    parent_id TEXT REFERENCES plans(id), archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )

CREATE TABLE fixed_slots (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, weekdays TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_min INTEGER NOT NULL, end_min INTEGER NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE schedule_blocks (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, date TEXT NOT NULL, start_min INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_min INTEGER NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT REFERENCES plans(id), label TEXT,
    source TEXT NOT NULL, pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed',
    postpone_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    execution_quality TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full',
    is_day_spark INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_celebration INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )

CREATE TABLE backgrounds (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_id TEXT REFERENCES plans(id), content TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw_source_text TEXT, tags TEXT, applicable_dates TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL,
    captured_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me',
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL, badge TEXT, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
    attachments TEXT NOT NULL, captured_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'me',
    plan_id TEXT REFERENCES plans(id), block_id TEXT,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  )
